notes.title: VERSION 1.1.4
notes.content:
Fix: Fixed that deckbuilder numbers could sometimes be wrong when swapping decks
Fix: Fixed a rare bug with Propaganda placing cards on top of other cards
Fix: Fixed certain control settings not saving

notes.title: VERSION 1.1
notes.content:
Major: PowerCharge now supports the Steam Deck. Menus and certain parts of the interface will use the trackpad to simulate the mouse
Major: Reload system and Expert/Medium bot got major optimizations/consistency improvements/bug fixes
New: More input shortcuts
New: Buttons now show up near places you can use keyboard shortcuts / controller inputs. This can be disabled in settings
New: Redesigned popup boxes to look better (and more retro)
New: Improved UI in several areas
Fix: Fixed large RAM usage when playing against Expert/Medium bot
Fix: Fixed that simple bot could crash in rare circumstances where it's hand and fuel were full, or the grid was full
Bot: Improved how the bot sees lifespan cards, being more likely to void cards using Space Worm Cultist when they are almost out of lifespan
Card Change: Martian, Power: 5 => 7
Card Change: Cargo Cleaner, Power: 7 => 3
Card Change: Fuel Up, Max fuel increase: 9 => 7
Card Change: Optimize, Discount: -8 => -6
Card Change: Potion Maker, Plasma Shield can now be given to other cards. Power gain: 10 => 7
Card Change: Uncover Plans, Now sends cards to Lost in Space instead of The Void

notes.title: VERSION 1.01
notes.content:
Fix: Fixed a bug where the UI would disappear if clicking on your void with 0 cards in the void
Fix: Fixed that the Propaganda event could trigger with no valid targets
Card Change: DoS Attack, Fuel: 16 => 10
Card Change: Security Drone, Fuel: 16 => 13
Card Change: Short Circuit: Can no longer target immortal workers
